title: How MagicSpace SEO took StoryChief from 8k to 44k monthly clicks and cut CPA
summary: Case study of a 6-month SEO engagement for StoryChief, a content marketing SaaS up against Ahrefs, SEMrush and Backlinko. A mix of content, technical SEO, backlinks and conversion work grew organic clicks 6x, made SEO the source of 80% of leads, and replaced PPC that had a CPA above $2,000.

principles.text: SEO is a long-term, cost-effective alternative to PPC for acquiring customers.
principles.quote: Sustainable growth: SEO provided a long-term, cost-effective solution compared to PPC.

principles.text: Combine content, technical SEO and off-page work; the mix beats any single lever.
principles.quote: Holistic approach: Combining content, technical SEO, and off-page strategies yielded powerful results.

principles.text: You can beat industry giants in a crowded market with a focused multi-faceted SEO strategy.
principles.quote: Competitive edge: StoryChief successfully competed against industry leaders in a crowded market.

principles.text: Judge channels by acquisition cost; shifting from PPC to SEO dramatically cut CPA.
principles.quote: ROI focus: The shift from PPC to SEO dramatically reduced customer acquisition costs.

principles.text: Pair SEO with conversion optimization, email nurture and distribution so traffic becomes leads.
